title: Windows 7/8.1

active_claim.scope: Continue the #721 Windows 7 interaction/model-load blocker only: use current descendant PR #736 to isolate the first crashing model-load stage with one physical probe at a time; preserve Win8.1/10/11 behavior and do not merge before target evidence.
